name: visually-hidden
title: Visually hidden
description: Text that screen readers read but the page does not show.

when: A heading that names a region the layout already makes obvious.
Context an icon or a glyph gives sighted users.

instead.when: A link to jump past the navigation.

guidance.rule: Never hide something a sighted user needs to read.

builtIn: Hidden with the sr-only technique, so it stays in the accessibility tree.
`isFocusable`: shown while it has keyboard focus.
